scope: resident–streaming CIM Roofline; language-backbone matrix sublayers only

definitions.Q_S: 窗口内经过声明 streaming 输入边界并被服务的逻辑操作数字节累计量
definitions.Q_R: 窗口内建立、更新或重载可计算 resident 状态的逻辑写入字节累计量
definitions.Q_R_zero: RI=Infinity (symbolic endpoint, not a JSON nonfinite number)
definitions.shape_N_K: N output dimension, K input dimension

parameters.B_definition: 同一份FFN／单路由专家权重一次驻留期间实际服务的输入向量总数；不是批次数，不自动等于全局batch size
parameters.scan: B only for FFN/MoE; L only for Attention rows; no B×L Cartesian product

rows.label: Weight-static
rows.resident_policy: weights pre-resident; no writes inside the window

rows.label: Per-use reloaded
rows.resident_policy: fully load the analyzed weights before every one-vector use

table_IIa.shapes_are: logical tasks, not five physical macro designs

rows.label: FFN / MoE
rows.unit: one dense FFN or one routed expert FFN
rows.window: one loading followed by B input-vector uses, then replacement

rows.label: Attention Prefill
rows.window: establish segment KV and complete corresponding causal Attention matrix tasks

table_IIb.main_table_priority: RI; three values follow B/L order in the applicable rows

selection_rules: Keep the six models in fixed order; no substitution or ranking.
Language backbone only; exclude vision/audio encoders.
For hybrid architectures select native full GQA, not linear Attention, Mamba or MLA.
Use full/global GQA where global and sliding-window attention coexist.
Preserve native heads and actual QK/V dimensions; do not force GQA-8.
Record actual layer topology; selected sublayer is not the entire model.
Residency, B and L are study scenarios, not claimed execution facts from model reports.
step1_exclusions: end-to-end performance, accuracy or hardware simulation
